subject: cudaMemcpy GpuBuffer::Download failed an illegal memory access was encountered

messages.author: Renato Araujo
messages.body:
Dear amber users I'm trying to run a protein/binder simulation and I'm
getting the following error:
cudaMemcpy GpuBuffer::Download failed an illegal memory access was
encountered
Could someone help me solve it? thankful
-- 
Prof Dr Renato Costa
Instituto Federal do Pará - IFPA
Grupo de Modelagem Molecular - UFPA

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Jan 04, 2022, Renato Araujo wrote:
>Dear amber users I'm trying to run a protein/binder simulation and I'm
>getting the following error:
>
>cudaMemcpy GpuBuffer::Download failed an illegal memory access was
>encountered
This message says nothing more than "something went wrong". Study the mdout
file for hints. See if you can run a short CPU simulation, especially if
this error happens near the beginning of a run. Be sure you have minimized
your structure before start md with GPU.
Above are all just guesses, based on things that commonly go wrong. There
are, in fact, almost an uncountable number of ways a simulation can fail, so
you have some detective work to do here.
...good luck...dac
